name: Stylist
source: Dreaming of becoming a stylist, a girl leaves town and makes her way to NY. Meeting 5 men, she enjoys her life whilst chasing her dream. Everything was fine until a rival female steps in... Can you achieve your dream? Which man will you choose?
translation: Dreaming of becoming a stylist, a girl leaves town and makes her way to NY. Meeting 5 men, she enjoys her life whilst chasing her dream. Everything was fine until a rival female steps in... Can you achieve your dream? Which man will you choose?
